name: acadium-agent-publisher
description: Let Claude write, schedule and publish posts on your WordPress site, within the rules you set in WordPress.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to a WordPress site running the Acadium Agent Publisher plugin. Claude signs in as the site's AI Agent user with an Application Password, and the plugin enforces the site's publishing mode (drafts only, submit for review, publish, or publish and edit live posts) and pre-publish checks.

In WordPress, go to Settings > Agent Publisher > Connect Claude, open "Can't use the connector?", and create an Application Password. Paste the connection URL, the username and the password into this extension's settings.

Most sites can instead add the connection URL as a custom connector (Settings > Connectors), which needs no extension or password.
